Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Preflight clearance scan: GTM / Enablement / Pricing / Docs / Support — QBR OKR sync

Team — circling up before the QBR to surface any last-mile blockers across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support. Goal: agree on a short list of immutable preflight items we need closed by Tuesday EOD so the launch can be represented cleanly in the QBR deck.

Attached: Preflight_Checklist_v3.xlsx (master checklist), QBR_OKR_Gaps.csv (current open OKR deltas)

Quick summary / asks:
- GTM (Marissa): confirm demo cadence and partner readiness for the pilot next week — any unresolved legal/coop comms?
- Enablement (Laura): finalize sales play + one-pager; confirm SME availability for enablement webinar (Thu).
- Pricing (Kimberly): confirm discount ladder and procurement docs for the approved pilot accounts.
- Docs (Karthik): publish the integration notes and runbook to Drive; call out any API caveats.
- Support (Naomi): confirm coverage hours and escalation SOP for the pilot region.

Please reply with status (green/amber/red), single blocker if red, and owner for remediation. I’ll synthesize and escalate only the red items to Ops and Executive Review.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Go-to-Market Operations
Redwood Inference

- Chase Orenda for co-demo slide by EOD Mon.

Thanks — Marissa

What’s good:
- Discount ladder approved for pilot cohort (legal + finance sign-off).
- Procurement packet drafted and uploaded to Drive.

Outstanding items:
1) PO terms: Orenda has one question on invoicing cadence vs. milestone dates (Mary, can your procurement SME confirm milestone tolerance?). Owner: Kimberly to provide suggested language by Mon noon.

If both items resolve Monday, pricing slides can be locked. If not, we’ll call out the dependency in the QBR slide with proposed mitigations.

Thanks for the fast turnarounds — summary and next steps below (consolidated for the QBR slide). I’ll only escalate anything still red by Tue 5pm PT.

Final snapshot (status / primary owner / commitment):
- GTM landing page (Amber) / Marissa / fallback placeholder by Mon 12:00 PT; final by Wed.
- Enablement SME quote (Amber) / Laura / Product to confirm by Mon 10:00 PT (dry run Tue 11:00 PT).
- Pricing invoices & billing tag (Amber -> Green expected) / Kimberly & Naomi / Kimberly suggested PO language by Mon 12:00 PT; Naomi to confirm billing tag Tue AM.
- Docs publication (Green) / Karthik / Runbook uploaded to Drive; two minor API caveats called out in checklist.
- Support coverage (Green) / Naomi / 24x5 pilot coverage confirmed; escalation SOP uploaded.

Hard blockers to escalate (none classified as RED at this time):
- Marketing creative delays causing demo invite link latency — Marissa to deliver fallback by noon Monday.
- Orenda procurement question on invoice cadence — Mary, can you confirm whether milestone-aligned invoicing within a 30-day tolerance is acceptable?

QBR representation guidance:
- I’ll present the launch as ‘on-track with contingencies’ and call out the two amber items with owners and committed dates. If either remains amber after Tue 5pm PT, we’ll include a brief mitigation plan in the QBR slides.

Please reply only if something changes materially or if you need me to escalate to Exec Review sooner.

Thanks — Vivek
